title: sources.json
description: Source registry. Every fact cites a source_id; the registry records the robots.txt and terms-of-service decision. Sources of kind company_submission and official_reference are read or received by a person, not fetched by the scraper, so robots and ToS decisions may be not_applicable.

url.description: Null only for a source whose URL was not located and that has use_allowed false.

source_kind.description: company_site: a company's own public site. official_record: government record or file. official_reference: official reference page (statute, agency guidance). company_submission: fact supplied by the company itself (rendered 'Provided by the company, DATE'). third_party_directory: aggregator or directory (never a value source). lead_unverified: search result or list, not a data source.

use_allowed.description: False means no published fact may cite this source.
